questions.label: Verify Tokyo transfer and baggage
questions.response: Confirmed: immediate same-day NRT international connection; onward boarding pass issued and baggage checked through. No Japanese immigration clearance. HK registration is successful, current and matched to this passport; the printed notification slip is held.

rationale: The confirmed Narita transfer stays airside. Indian citizenship does not create a Japanese visa requirement for this connection. Matching successful registration and its notification slip cover the short Hong Kong visit.
